profile.description: All prices and power rates are explicit synthetic assumptions. Attendance wages exclude walking, setup crews and salaried standby. Active machine power includes standby; family-setup gaps consume standby only. No solar, battery, export, demand charge or grid-cap optimization is claimed.

protocol.scope: Exact plan-cost and capacity-fee sensitivity; original native plans optimize priority objective, not money
